host_delta: Fold packet aggregation into the existing transient FIELD machine handoff: every packet reduces to exactly one of NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE without becoming a queue, store, route, or authority source.
law: Packet egress is derived, never packet-authorized. Canonical precedence is GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE. Only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context can create NOW; packet current/state/egress labels cannot. Unwitnessed material change is RESIDUE. STOP suppresses continuation; historical/superseded material remains ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated.
changes: /lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs — pure deterministic reducer + hard non-promotion boundary
/showcase-manifest.json — FIELD root touch only; no new route/version
/.github/workflows/public-surface-check.yml — run A-H reducer proof inside existing JIT FIELD handoff gate
/lib/field-egress-reducer.mjs + /tools/field-egress-reducer-selftest.mjs — restore recovered GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE precedence
preserves: historical worker packets remain non-runnable by presence
no new route, dashboard, queue, store, planner, ontology, or canonical packet cache
residue: The reducer classifies egress only; it does not choose project priority or execute NEXT.
Legacy packets without explicit EVIDENCE can no longer claim DELTA merely by naming a change; they remain RESIDUE until witnessed.
External/private packets are reduced only when explicitly supplied to the existing transient transcript CLI.
stop: Do not render another packet dashboard. Propagate only if a real consumer needs the reduced egress.
correction: PR #557 restored canonical precedence but still allowed packet.current / ACTIVE_NOW state to create NOW without caller authority.
NOW now requires caller-supplied context.now or context.selected; authority.can_select_now=false blocks that promotion and survives as RESIDUE.
Packet egress/egress_class/field_egress is advisory only and cannot manufacture NOW, NEXT, DELTA, RESIDUE or GATE.
DELTA requires material change plus sufficient evidence; an unwitnessed material-change claim reduces to RESIDUE.
STOP dominates continuation: STOP+condition → GATE; STOP+residue/unwitnessed change → RESIDUE; otherwise STOP → ARCHIVE.
Canonical exists:false/material:false fields do not manufacture attention.
